name: build-trimmer
description: Trims long xcodebuild and swift build/test output to the errors, failing tests and summary, keeping the full log on disk

developerDir.title: Xcode developer dir
developerDir.description: Optional DEVELOPER_DIR to build with, e.g. /Applications/Xcode-beta.app/Contents/Developer. Empty = off (use your default Xcode)

developerDirPathMatch.title: Only when path contains
developerDirPathMatch.description: Use the developer dir above only when the command or working folder contains this text (e.g. /MyApp). Empty = every build

extraBuildScripts.title: Extra build scripts
extraBuildScripts.description: Comma-separated script names that run xcodebuild or swift test themselves, e.g. test.sh,ci/build.sh
